description: This file defines interface functions, macros, and constants for integrating Lua scripting support into the lighttpd server core. It declares external references to Lua state management, protection, and environment handling, as well as functions for working with various lighttpd core components such as chunks, environment, filters, headers, physical resources, requests, responses, statistics, and virtual requests within a Lua context.

methods.name: li_lua_state_get
methods.description: Retrieves the internal Lua state object from the given lua_State pointer.

methods.description: Locks the Lua state to ensure thread safety.
